scenario: LCAP.2.9 / LDIA.3.4.2 — negative: the program sets `float: false` and writes `/` between two Int slots, which produces a `Float` ([LCAP.2.9]'s hint is `//`). `INT_LIT / INT_LIT` would be a Rational literal and not a site, so the operands are slots. Rejected with DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED. Drives dsc.dialect's own_sites (`bo_div`).
rules_ds:
use default:
    float: false

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
    w: Int mutable

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v / t.w > 1
->
    log info "x"
